x: Worrall won the second string in 51.5 (probably 'niggled' at not being selected as No. 1.) Couzens won the Javelin (155'.1"), Kerr won the mile (4:18.1) and Mike Smithers popped up in several spots to collect valuable points.

We are still extremely weak in this department but we are slowly forming a nucleus of stars -Boosey, Clair, Wade - and we are gradually gaining a number of reliable Club men - Couzens, Leyer, Silvester.

Lawton, Satchell, Gorman, Pearson and Couzens who worked up to 1am the previous night getting the Hall ready. It was good to see the slim and stylish figure of Eric Hall competing in the Club 3,000 metres walking championship.
Subsequent draws have been held every 3rd Saturday of the month at Belgrave Hall when a convivial evening is provided by mine host - Bill Couzens - and his team of helpers.

One final word about the other team - the Belgrave Supporters who cheered everything in claret and gold whilst consuming vast quantities of roast chicken, washed down by numerous bottles of wine. Boozey lot those Couzens, Pritchards and Richleys. 100: A - M.Alleyne (Disq.); B - 3.R.Vassall 11.8, 200.
